Bundle info -10%Your Price:$116.84 Add to Cart Add to Account Content For This GameBrowse all (1) Recommended Portal 2 Soundtrack Free View Community Hub Recent Events & Announcements About This Game Portal 2 draws from the award-winning formula of innovative gameplay, story, and music that earned the original Portal over 70 industry accolades and created a cult following. The single-player portion of Portal 2 introduces a cast of dynamic new characters, a host of fresh puzzle elements, and a much larger set of devious test chambers. Players will explore never-before-seen areas of the Aperture Science Labs and be reunited with GLaDOS, the occasionally murderous computer companion who guided them through the original game. The game’s two-player cooperative mode features its own entirely separate campaign with a unique story, test chambers, and two new player characters. This new mode forces players to reconsider everything they thought they knew about portals. Success will require them to not just act cooperatively, but to think cooperatively. Product Features Extensive single player: Featuring next generation gameplay and a wildly-engrossing story. Complete two-person co-op: Multiplayer game featuring its own dedicated story, characters, and gameplay. Advanced physics: Allows for the creation of a whole new range of interesting challenges, producing a much larger but not harder game. Original music. Massive sequel: The original Portal was named 2007's Game of the Year by over 30 publications worldwide. Editing Tools: Portal 2 editing tools will be included. The puzzles are clever without being cruel, the pacing is perfect and every solution makes you feel like a genius for about five glorious seconds. GLaDOS is still the undefeated passive aggressive queen, Wheatley is living proof that giving an idiot too much power is always funny and the writing somehow hits harder than most modern games trying way too hard. The co-op mode is basically couples therapy with lasers. It looks great, sounds great and still feels fresh years later. Valve really woke up and chose excellence. About 12 years ago, we played through the co-op and had so much fun alongside the multiple arguements, and fights we had after one of us would fail a puzzle or when i'd just sit there and do nothing because he made me mad in some sort of way. What sucks, is that i never knew that in about a year, or couple of months, that i would just never be able to talk to him ever again. My brother was diagnosed with Neuroblastoma, i never knew what that meant when i was younger and all that connected in my brain was that my brother was sleepy sometimes and thats really it. Only when I found out he would not be coming back from the hospital did i feel such pain. As of recently, i started replaying the xbox version of portal and i am having a great time. The game is amazing, i love everything about it. Its incredibly nostalgic.
